title: Just Juice Strawberry & Curuba 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Strawberry & Curuba from Just Juice’s Exotic Fruit collection is a silky-sweet and deliciously smooth combination of luscious strawberries blended with Curuba, also known as banana passionfruit outside South America, which carries notes of passionfruit and peach with a delightful sour note on the exhale. The ratio of 50% Vegetable Glycerine, 50% Propylene Glycol delivers a perfect balance of clouds, vapour and flavour and is ideal for use with starter vape kits , compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
